contentEn:
Planning a townhouse renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026? Reno Stars has completed more than 60 whole-home and kitchen-bath upgrades across Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey, and White Rock. This guide shares real 2026 pricing from our project database — not estimates copied from U.S. blogs.

The short answer: a typical townhouse renovation in Metro Vancouver runs $25,000 for a single bathroom refresh, $40,000–$85,000 for a full kitchen remodel, and $90,000–$250,000 for a whole-home renovation. Exact costs depend on your townhouse's age, layout, and finishes.

What Drives Townhouse Renovation Cost in Metro Vancouver

Townhouses in Vancouver's Metro region share structural walls with neighbouring units and are governed by strata councils. That creates unique costs that a freehold home renovation estimate does not account for:

  • Strata approval requirements for any work affecting shared walls, plumbing risers, or exterior alterations — add 2–6 weeks and $500–$3,000 in approval fees
  • condo (strata) insurance notification requirements
  • Narrow lots limiting material delivery and staging access
  • BC Building Code Part 9 requirements for any structural alterations in attached dwellings

Reno Stars handles all strata approval submissions as part of our project management fee. We have successfully obtained approvals for attached-wall kitchen extensions and multi-bathroom projects in Richmond, Burnaby, and Surrey townhouse complexes.

Kitchen Renovation Costs: Townhouse Units, Metro Vancouver 2026

A townhouse kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver typically costs $40,000–$85,000 in 2026. The range reflects finish level, whether cabinets are custom or semi-custom, and whether plumbing or gas rough-in relocation is required.

The most common townhouse kitchen renovation scope in our project history is a cabinet-refacing plus new quartz countertop and updated lighting — this typically runs $28,000–$42,000. A full gut renovation with custom cabinets, island addition, and relocated plumbing runs $55,000–$85,000.

Kitchen Renovation ScopeTypical Cost Range (2026)Timeline
Cabinet refacing + new quartz countertop + lighting$28,000 – $42,0006–10 weeks
Semi-custom cabinets, new layout, appliance swap$42,000 – $62,00010–14 weeks
Custom cabinets, structural wall opening, full rough-in$62,000 – $85,00014–20 weeks

All prices above include Reno Stars' project management fee, BC Building Permit fees, and strata notification. They exclude appliance purchases unless noted.

See our work on a Vancouver whole-house project that included a full kitchen remodel: Vancouver custom whole-house renovation.

Bathroom Renovation Costs: Metro Vancouver Townhouses 2026

A townhouse bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver costs $8,000–$30,000 in 2026, depending on whether it is a powder-room refresh or a full primary bath gut.

Common scopes and costs:

Bathroom Renovation ScopeTypical Cost Range (2026)Timeline
Powder-room refresh (toilet, vanity, tile floor, lighting)$8,000 – $14,0003–5 weeks
Standard bath gut (full tile, new tub/shower, vanity, toilet, exhaust$14,000 – $22,0005–8 weeks
Primary bath with curbless shower, double vanity, heated floor$22,000 – $30,0008–12 weeks

Strata bylaws in Metro Vancouver townhouse complexes frequently restrict exterior cladding changes and noise hours for work in shared-wall buildings. Reno Stars submits all required strata notices before permits are applied for.

Whole-Home Townhouse Renovation Costs: Metro Vancouver 2026

A complete townhouse renovation — multiple rooms, both bathrooms, kitchen, flooring, and electrical updates — typically costs $90,000–$250,000 in 2026. The range reflects whether the scope includes structural changes.

Whole-Home ScopeTypical Cost Range (2026)Timeline
Multi-room refresh: flooring, paint, trim, bathroom updates, kitchen facelift$60,000 – $95,00012–18 weeks
Full gut including custom cabinetry, new bathrooms, reconfigured layout$95,000 – $160,00018–28 weeks
Structural renovation including load-bearing wall removal, new rough-in, custom build$160,000 – $250,000+28–40+ weeks

Cost Differences by City in Metro Vancouver

Rough cost comparators by city are based on permit valuation data from the City of Vancouver, City of Richmond, and City of Surrey 2025 construction valuation reports:

CityTypical Townhouse Renovation Premium vs. Vancouver Baseline
Vancouver (UBC area to Burnaby border)Baseline
Richmond5–8% lower
Burnaby / New Westminster3–6% lower
Coquitlam / Port Moody2–5% lower
Surrey / White Rock8–12% lower

Rates are lower in Surrey and White Rock primarily due to labour availability and lower average permit valuation per square foot. Vancouver and West Vancouver carry a premium due to higher trades rates and more complex permitting.

How Long Does a Townhouse Renovation Take in Metro Vancouver?

Timeline factors in permit issuance timelines from the City of Vancouver (currently 4–8 weeks for renovation permits), BC Building Code Part 9 review, and any strata council approval windows (30–45 days in most Metro Vancouver complexes).

For a full kitchen and two-bathroom townhouse renovation in Richmond, Surrey, or Burnaby, a realistic timeline is 14–22 weeks from contract signing to final inspection.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a permit for a townhouse renovation in Metro Vancouver?

Yes, for any work that changes the structure, alters plumbing, adds electrical circuits, or modifies shared walls. In Vancouver, permits for attached-dwelling renovations are processed under BC Building Code Part 9. Reno Stars submits all permit applications and manages inspector visits.

Can I renovate my townhouse kitchen without strata approval?

Cosmetic work (changing flooring material, painting, replacing countertops) typically does not require strata approval. Anything that affects shared walls, plumbing risers, or structural elements requires strata council approval. Reno Stars handles the approval process as part of every project.

What is the average cost per square foot for a townhouse renovation in Metro Vancouver?

Based on completed Reno Stars projects in 2025–2026, the average cost is $110–$180 per square foot of renovated floor area, depending on scope. This includes all labour, materials, permits, and project management.

Are townhouse renovations more expensive than single-family homes?

Per square foot, townhouse renovations in Metro Vancouver can be 10–20% more expensive than comparable detached-home renovations due to strata approval requirements, shared-wall constraints, and limited site access. However, total project costs are typically lower because townhouse units are smaller (1,200–1,800 sq ft of renovated area is common).

Does Reno Stars offer free consultations for townhouse projects?

Yes. Reno Stars offers a complimentary in-home consultation for townhouse renovation projects in Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey, and White Rock. Contact us to book your free quote.

計劃在2026年裝修大溫哥華鎮屋？聚星裝修已完成超過60個溫哥華、列治文、本拿比、高貴林、素里及白石鎮的整屋及廚房浴室改造項目。本文分享來自我們項目數據庫的真實2026年價格，而非抄襲美國博客的估算。

簡要答案：大溫哥華鎮屋裝修典型費用為——單間浴室翻新25,000加元、全屋廚房裝修40,000至85,000加元、整屋裝修90,000至250,000加元。準確費用取決於鎮屋的建造年份、戶型及選材檔次。

影響大溫哥華鎮屋裝修費用的因素

溫哥華都市區的鎮屋與相鄰單位共用牆體，受業主委員會（strata）管理。這產生獨立屋裝修估算中不存在的特殊費用：

  • 任何影響共用牆、排水立管或外牆改動的工程需獲strata批准——額外增加2至6週及500至3,000加元審批費用
  • 共管（strata）保險通知要求
  • 狭窄地塊限制材料交付及施工場地布置
  • BC建築規範第9部對連排住宅結構改建的要求

聚星裝修將所有strata申請提交作為項目管理費的一部分。我們已成功為列治文、本拿比及素里鎮屋小區的承重牆廚房擴建及多浴室項目獲得審批。

廚房裝修費用：大溫哥華鎮屋2026年

2026年大溫哥華鎮屋廚房裝修費用通常為40,000至85,000加元。價差反映選材檔次、櫥櫃為定制還是半定制，以及是否需要移動水管或燃氣管道。

我們項目記錄中最常見的鎮屋廚房裝修範圍是櫥櫃面翻新升級石英岩台面及更新照明——這類項目通常為28,000至42,000加元。全面拆舊翻新定製櫥櫃、添加中島並移動管道的項目為55,000至85,000加元。

廚房裝修範圍2026年典型費用區間工期
櫥櫃面翻新 + 新石英岩台面 + 照明升級28,000 – 42,000 加元6–10 週
半定制櫥櫃、新佈局、家電更換42,000 – 62,000 加元10–14 週
定制櫥櫃、建築牆開孔、管道全面預設62,000 – 85,000 加元14–20 週

以上價格均含聚星裝修項目管理費、BC建築許可費及strata通知費。不含家電採購（除非另有說明）。

浴室裝修費用：大溫哥華鎮屋2026年

2026年大溫哥華鎮屋浴室裝修費用為8,000至30,000加元，具體取決於是化妝間小翻新還是主卧浴室全面拆舊。

常見範圍及費用：

浴室裝修範圍2026年典型費用區間工期
化妝間翻新（馬桶、浴室櫃、瓷磚地板、照明）8,000 – 14,000 加元3–5 週
標準浴室全面翻新瓷磚、新浴缸/淋浴間、浴室櫃、馬桶、排氣扇14,000 – 22,000 加元5–8 週
主卧浴室無障礙淋浴、雙台面浴室櫃、地暖22,000 – 30,000 加元8–12 週

大溫哥華鎮屋小區的strata附例通常限制外牆改動及共享牆體工程的施工時間。聚星裝修在申請許可證前提交所有必需的strata通知。

整屋鎮屋裝修費用：大溫哥華2026年

全面鎮屋裝修——多個房間、兩間浴室、廚房、地板及電氣更新——2026年典型費用為90,000至250,000加元。價差反映工程是否含結構改建。

整屋裝修範圍2026年典型費用區間工期
多房間翻新：地板、牆面油漆、踢腳線、浴室更新、廚房小翻新60,000 – 95,000 加元12–18 週
含定制櫥櫃、新浴室、佈局重新配置的全拆翻新95,000 – 160,000 加元18–28 週
含承重牆拆除、新管道預設、定制施工的結構裝修160,000 – 250,000+ 加元28–40+ 週

大溫哥華各市費用差異

以下各市大致費用比較基於溫哥華市、列治文市及素里市2025年建築估值報告：

城市相對溫哥華基準的典型鎮屋裝修費用差異
溫哥華（UBC學區至本拿比邊界）基準線
列治文低5–8%
本拿比 / 新西敏低3–6%
高貴林 / 穆迪港低2–5%
素里 / 白石低8–12%

素里和白石的報價較低，主要因為技工供應更充足及每平方英尺平均許可估值較低。溫哥華和西溫因技工費率較高及許可審批更複雜而價格偏高。

大溫哥華鎮屋裝修需要多長時間？

工期因素包括：溫哥華市目前的裝修許可證發放時間（4至8週）、BC建築規範第9部審批，以及任何strata理事會審批窗口期（大溫哥華多數小區為30至45天）。

對於列治文、素里或本拿比含完整廚房和兩間浴室的鎮屋裝修項目，從簽約到最終驗收的現實工期為14至22週。

常見問題

在大溫哥華裝修鎮屋需要許可證嗎？

需要。任何改變結構、管道改動、增加電路或改動共享牆體的工程都需要許可證。在溫哥華，連排住宅裝修許可證按BC建築規範第9部辦理。聚星裝修提交所有許可證申請並管理督察探訪。

我可以不經strata批准就裝修鎮屋廚房嗎？

cosmetic裝修（更換地板材料、油漆、更換台面）通常不需要strata批准。任何影響共享牆、排水立管或結構元素的工程都需要strata理事會批准。聚星裝修作為每個項目的一部分處理批准流程。

大溫哥華鎮屋裝修每平方英尺平均費用是多少？

基於2025–2026年聚星裝修已完成項目，每平方英尺裝修費用為110至180加元，具體取決於工程範圍。這包含所有人工、材料、許可證及項目管理費。

鎮屋裝修比獨立屋更貴嗎？

按平方英尺計算，大溫哥華鎮屋裝修可能比同檔獨立屋裝修貴10至20%，因為strata批准要求、共享牆限制及施工場地限制。但因鎮屋戶型較小（常見裝修面積1,200至1,800平方英尺），項目總價通常更低。

聚星裝修是否提供鎮屋項目免費諮詢？

是的。聚星裝修為溫哥華、列治文、本拿比、高貴林、素里及白石的鎮屋裝修項目提供免費上門諮詢。聯繫我們預約免費報價。
